modules.module_title: Introduction to Job Role & Work Requirements

pcs.pc_description: Understand the scope of the Electrician role, including planning, designing, installing, and maintaining electrical and electronic sub-systems in residential, commercial, and industrial setups.
Gain awareness of safety standards, energy- efficient solutions, smart and IoT-enabled systems, and renewable energy components.
Communicate with the supervisor to understand day to day working requirements.
Apply approved drawings, job instructions, or manuals, including digital formats like AutoCAD or BIM.

modules.module_title: Prepare materials and tools & Safety Practices

pcs.pc_description: Collect required consumables, along with smart devices, IoT modules, energy-efficient components, and renewable energy modules.
Inspect boards, panels, and components for damage, loose connections, or incorrect parts, including surge protection and solar PV components.
Identify and deal with workplace hazards such as sharp edges, exposed wiring, or incorrect installation areas.
Use PPE kit and Apply fire safety and ESD practices while handling flammable materials and electrical equipment.
Assemble electrical sub-systems following SOPs, ensuring correct handling of smart/renewable installations.
Interpret drawings and job instructions accurately, including IoT/automation schematics for residential, commercial, and industrial setups.
Identify and report errors or inadequate components, including digital/smart modules.
Install wiring, control panels, and distribution boards according to setup type (residential, commercial, or industrial), following energy- efficient and smart system standards.
Ensure proper earthing, surge protection, and isolation points for each setup
Maintain clear documentation of installations, including digital logs or BIM updates, for future maintenance or audits.
Follow emergencies, rescue, and first-aid procedures applicable during installation tasks.

pcs.pc_description: Test installations before energizing for safety, using modern test kits such power quality analyzer, etc
Verify correct operation of energized installations, including smart MCCBs, RCDs/RCBOs, digital relays, and renewable energy systems.
Configure and program devices and bus- systems, including KNX, DALI, Modbus, IoT/cloud- based systems, and app-controlled automation.
Ensure installations are fully functional and demonstrate operations to the customer, including remote/app-based control and energy monitoring.
Identify and deal with workplace hazards during testing and troubleshooting, including live circuits and smart/IoT devices.
Apply fire safety practices while performing commissioning or repair on energized equipment.
Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in electrical systems, including short/open circuits, incorrect polarity, high loop impedance, bad connections, smart/IoT modules, and renewable energy systems.
Repair or replace faulty components, including smart sensors, IoT modules, EV charging systems, and renewable energy device
Verify installations comply with current standards, including updated IEC/IS codes and energy-efficient installation guidelines.
Perform maintenance tasks across residential, commercial, and industrial setups, ensuring continuity, safety, and integration with smart/IoT/renewable systems.
Use advanced diagnostic and testing tools, including multimeters, clamp meters, network testers, and power quality analyzers.
Maintain proper documentation of tests, repairs, and upgrades, including digital logs for smart systems.
Follow emergencies, rescue, and first-aid procedures during maintenance or fault repair tasks.
Apply effective waste management and recycling practices for components, packaging, and electrical scrap.
Suggest improvements for energy efficiency and smart system upgrades in existing installations.
